title: 5. Gram Sabha – Foundation of Panchayati Raj

blocks.content:
Gram Sabha consists of all registered voters in a village.

Functions:
• Approves plans and budgets
• Promotes social audit
• Ensures transparency

Gram Sabha is considered the foundation of rural democracy.
Gram Sabha is considered the foundation of rural democracy.

items: Gram Sabha membership is limited to registered voters, not every adult resident of the village.
Key powers of Gram Sabha include plan and budget approvals along with social audits.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Gram Sabha consists of all registered voters living in a village.
It holds the power to approve village plans and budgets.
It promotes social audit and ensures transparency in local administration.
It forms the core foundation of rural democracy in Panchayati Raj.
